title: Picked geometry shows an internal id ("welded face 0x885acc..."): one shared user-friendly name for each face, edge and vertex

body:
The maintainer reported this in chat on 2026-11-17 and set the priority (`P2`):

> bug, p2; in alot of the dialogs we get a weird name for "picked" - like this welded face 0x885acc.. in general all the welded features, faces, edges, vertices on both stock an models.. should get better naming conventions, and those names should be stored in a internal array showing a "user friendly" name for the face, edge, vertice... but keeping track internally what is actually picked... We have this partially on geometry tab of operations, but i dont get the feeling its a universal globally shared feature which it should be.

**What the screenshot shows**
- The WCS page, group "Set WCS from features", while picking with the role Z.
- The line reads: `Picked: welded face 0x885acc46fbeb60ff of 'fig8' sets Z`.
- The hexadecimal number is the internal id of the welded face. It tells the user nothing.

**What is wrong**
- Dialogs that show a picked item print the internal id.
- The Geometry tab of an operation has friendlier names in part. Other pages do not use them. There is no single source for the name of a picked item.

**Requested behaviour**
1. Each pickable item of a model and of a stock has a user-friendly name: welded features, faces, edges and vertices. Example form: "Face 12 of 'fig8'", or a name by kind where the kind is known (plane, cylinder, hole).
2. One shared table holds the name for each internal id. The internal id stays the reference for what is picked. Commands and the project file keep the internal reference.
3. Each page and dialog that shows a picked item reads the name from that table: the WCS page, the Geometry tab, stock and fixture picks, hole and chain picks, the status line.
4. A name is stable while the model does not change. The same item has the same name on each page.
5. The table is derived data. It is calculated one time for each model change and cached, not on each frame.
6. No user-facing string shows a hexadecimal id.

**First step**
- List each place in `crates/ui` and `crates/app` that formats a picked item for the user. Record the list in a comment here.
- Decide the naming convention and where the table lives (`app` holds the document; code that works only on geometry values goes in the crate that owns them). Record the decision in `docs/decisions/`.

Done means:
- The WCS page shows a user-friendly name for the picked face, edge or vertex.
- All listed places read the shared table.
- A test asserts that no pick label has a `0x` id, and that the same item has the same name on two pages.
- MCP tools that return a picked item return the name with the internal reference.
